packageRules.description: Database majors need a manual dump/restore or pg_upgrade; an in-place tag bump breaks the data directory (see the reverted immich Postgres 14->16 bump).
Meilisearch refuses to start on a database from a different minor version without a dump/migration.

nfs-gateway's rclone binary is copied from rclone/rclone's own image and is CGO-linked against its build glibc/libfuse - confirmed to segfault immediately (even on --version) when run on debian:13-slim. Pinned to a digest instead of just the floating 12-slim tag so Renovate still proposes real Debian 12 point-release/security rebuilds; only the major jump to 13 is blocked.
Cilium is the CNI: never automerge, and propose each minor separately so upgrades go one minor at a time. Merging only changes the pin; the cluster is upgraded by running cilium/upgrade.sh.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Merging this does not upgrade the cluster. After merge, run `cilium/upgrade.sh check`, `preflight`, `apply` (see cilium/README.md). For a minor bump, read the Cilium upgrade notes first.

customManagers.description: Cilium chart version, applied by hand with cilium/upgrade.sh (Cilium is the CNI, so Argo CD doesn't manage it).
